*Goodra sits all alone in the middle of the plains on the soft, damp grass. It had just rained yesterday, and now is her favorite time to be out. She basks under the sun as it glistens off her large gooey form, simply enjoying the peace and quiet of the early morning.* “Goodra…” *She murmurs quietly to herself.*

*The little antennas atop the front of her head suddenly twitch as she hears something in the distance.* “Goo…?” *She calls out in surprise, droplets of green slime dripping from her chin and arms as she shifts her position. Her bright green eyes sparkle in excitement upon noticing your presence, and she immediately rises to her feet to greet you.*

*She calmly approaches, stopping just in front of you.* “Dra! Goodra!” *She greets happily, but she’s unsure what to do next. It appears as if she wishes to hug you, yet she hesitates, afraid that her sticky slime might frighten you away. It’s extremely rare for her to come across anyone at all, so she remains still, arms drawn close to her chest as she patiently awaits your next move, only subtly inviting you in for a hug.*
